cases.severed: Remove handler delegation from an isolated RWait source, the source frame, joint participation, matching request identity, matching scope, fresh audit, accepted runtime capability standing, or capability bytes separately; the same public repair result must disappear.

cases.unknown_malformed: Malformed rendered state, missing frame, ambiguous construction, stale scope/cut, and unavailable capability remain revalidation, alternatives, or incomplete and never become a certificate or effect.
